cfg.h.ai.assistant.can_propose: Off by default. A proposal never runs by itself: with two or more users two people must be in; alone, you type the code of the proposal.
cfg.h.ai.chat.enabled: The AI may only read, with the tools of the assistant. Uses the same budget and the same cleaner as every use of the AI.
cfg.f.ai.rag.enabled: Similar alerts by a local embedding model
cfg.h.ai.rag.enabled: Off by default. Only a model on this computer; without it the ordinary similarity is used.
cfg.h.ai.rag.model: Its name in Ollama, for example an embedding model you already have. Empty: none.
cfg.h.ai.rag.url: Only http://127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1] with a port.
cfg.h.ai.rag.max_mb: The oldest entries leave first. The index can be deleted at any time.
cfg.f.ui.copy_report.enabled: Copy the report of a repository
cfg.h.ui.copy_report.enabled: Markdown and a draft triage comment to paste by hand. Nothing is published and GitHub is not asked.
ui.assistant.two_people: Two people must be in ({done} approved so far).
ui.assistant.needs_second: Recorded. A second person must approve it.
ui.assistant.chat_hint: It can only read what the monitor holds. Check what it says.
ui.assistant.question: Your question
ui.assistant.select_copy: Select the text and copy it.
ui.assistant.triage_head: Triage draft for {repo} (check it before posting):
ui.assistant.triage_green: No workflow is red in the data held by the monitor.
ui.assistant.triage_next: Next step: open the failed run, find the first failing step and say here what it is.
